Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[r[:] for r in g]
    barrows=[r for r in range(h) if sum(x!=0 for x in g[r])>=2]

        for a,b in zip(nz,nz[1:]):
            for c in range(a[0]+1,b[0]):

    # vertical flood: for each nonzero cell below bars, grow upward/downward with same color, blocked by another color or existing non-zero? use BFS per color

    segs=[]
    for rr in range(m+1,h):
        for cc in range(w):
            v=res[rr][cc]
            if v==0 or visited[rr][cc]: continue
            color=v
            q=deque([(rr,cc)]); visited[rr][cc]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0)):

                if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not visited[ny][nx] and res[ny][nx]==0 and st<=ny<=end_:
                    visited[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx)); res[ny][nx]=col

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c in range(W):
        srcs=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) if g[r][c]]
        if not srcs: continue
        for r in range(H):
            best=min(srcs,key=lambda s:(abs(s[0]-r),-s[1]))
            if abs(best[0]-r)>0: res[r][c]=best[1]
    return res

def nearest_fill(g, vert=True, horiz=True, mode='ray', tiebreak=None, niter=None):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # start with horizontal nearest-fill (optional)

        for r in range(H):
            nz=[(c,g[r][c]) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]]
            if len(nz)<2: continue
            segs=[];st=None;prev=-1;runlen=0
            for c,v in nz:
                if st is None or c==prev+1: runlen+=1; prev=c
                else: segs.append((st,prev)); st=c; runlen=1
                prev=c
            if st is not None: segs.append((st,prev))
            left,right=segs[0],segs[-1]
            L,R=g[r][left[0]],g[r][right[0]]
            for s,e in segs[1:-1]:
                dl=s-left[1]; dr=e-right[0]
                pick=L if dl<=dr else R
                for cc in range(s+1,e): g[r][cc]=pick
    for it in range(niter+1) if niter else []:
        changed=True
        while changed:
            changed=False
            for c in range(W):
                nz=sorted((r,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) if g[r][c])
                for i,r0,v in enumerate(nz):
                    if i==0: continue
                    # gap above this cell
                    prev=nz[i-1]
                    lo,hi=r[0],v[0]-1
                    if hi-lo>=0 and g[r0][c]==v[1]:
                        changed=True
                        break
                for r in range(H):
                    if g[r][c]: continue
                    cands=[g[r'][c] for r' in range(H) if r'<r']+[g[r'][c] for r' in range(r+1,H)]
                    # ray-based candidates: nearest nonzero above/below
                    up=[g[rr][c] for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1) if g[rr][c]]; up=[u for u in up if u!=0]
                    dn=[g[rr][c] for rr in range(r+1,H) if g[rr][c]]
                    cand=(up+dn)
                    if not cand: continue
                    dists=[]
                    for vvv in cand:
                        rs=[rr for rr in (range(r-1,-1,-1) if vvv in [g[rr][c] for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1)] else []) ]
                        d=min(abs(rr-r) for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1) if g[rr][c]==vvv) if any(g[rr][c]==vvv for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1)) else 99
                        d2=min(abs(rr-r) for rr in range(r+1,H) if g[rr][c]==vvv) if any(g[rr][c]==vvv for rr in range(r+1,H)) else 99
                        dists.append((min(d,d2),vvv))
                    b=min(dists,key=lambda x:x[0])
                    g[r][c]=b[1]
                    changed=True
                    break
    return g
